name: Launch the Earth Workshop mission
description: Verifies the original Level 1 launch and oxygen regulation mission still work.
steps: Move the oxygen slider into the safe zone and lock it in
expected: The oxygen mission completes and the task-complete screen appears with the next mission action.

name: Harvest and save Level 1 food
description: Verifies the crop mission saves two fruits and two vegetables for the crew's later return journey.
steps: Harvest Star Fruit and Space Berries
Harvest Moon Lettuce and Solar Carrot
expected: The shared cargo inventory contains at least 2 fruits and 2 vegetables.

name: Collect Level 2 survival essentials
description: Verifies the runner requires only the supplies needed for the Level 3 crew.
expected: The runner completes after 3 oxygen, 1 protein bar, and 1 water pack are collected, and these amounts are saved.

name: Keep Return to Earth locked when cargo is incomplete
description: Verifies players cannot enter Level 3 until all required food and survival supplies have been collected.
steps: Open level selection with fewer than the required supplies
expected: Level 3 does not open and the player is told which quantities are still missing.

name: Pack collected supplies and rescue the crew
setup: Complete Level 1 crop harvesting to collect 2 fruits and 2 vegetables
Complete Level 2 runner collection to collect 3 oxygen, 1 protein bar, and 1 water
description: Verifies Level 3 uses previously collected resources instead of requiring purchases or coins.
steps: Select Return to Earth after the cargo requirements are met
Review the collected cargo in Check & Pack Supplies
Give each astronaut their required food and one oxygen canister
expected: The crew receives the correct food and oxygen from the shared inventory and the Earth return victory screen appears.

name: Use the resource runner controls on mobile
description: Verifies the updated oxygen, protein, and water collectibles remain usable on mobile.
steps: Open CosmoCrew on a mobile viewport
Select Level 2 and open the runner task
Swipe between lanes and use jump and slide controls
expected: The mobile runner responds to touch and displays the 3 oxygen, 1 protein, and 1 water targets.
